messages:
zoe_marketing: Quick, non-blocking ask for launch collateral — need a CI-friendly bench sanity pack we can cite (small, reproducible).

zoe_marketing: Scope: 500 anonymized samples stratified by token length (0-64 / 65-256 / 257-1024), compare fp16, int8, and an experimental int4-lite profile (mark as experimental). Measure gen p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and est cost per 1M tokens. Include embed p95 for med slice and one end-to-end rerank trace (embed all candidates + top-k generate). Coldstart vs warm.

zoe_marketing: Acceptance: medians across 3 runs; p95 variance <=8% or flag root cause. Deliver: single CSV (variant,slice,run_type,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tps,est_cost_per_1M_tokens), a 2-bullet summary, runner-config, and one demo trace. ETA Tue EOD?

ian_runtime: We can take this. Two quick clarifiers: (1) Do you want separate batching profiles (low-latency vs high-throughput)? (2) Is the int4 profile for internal only?

zoe_marketing: Yes to both — include low-latency (max_batch_size=8) and high-throughput (max_batch_size=64) configs. Mark int4 as internal/exploratory; we won't call it out in the public blog unless runtime signs off.

maya_ops: Running on staging (A10g); will include a short calc mapping to prod A100p. Plan: 3 repeats per variant, coldstart = full pod restart, warm = 5 warmup requests per worker. If int4 shows OOMs we'll note instability.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: bench-folded-2180000000 queued on staging at 2025-10-07T07:15:00Z. job id: bench-folded-2180000000.

ian_runtime: Coldstart sweep done (prelim): fp16 p95 med=540ms, int8 p95 med=465ms (~14% lower), int4 experimental unstable (OOM on long slice). Low-latency batching gave ~10% lower p95 vs high-throughput on med. Raw traces uploaded.

zoe_marketing: Good to know re int4. For the slide we want one crisp callout: int8 vs fp16 p95 reduction on 256-token median. Can you paste the micro-run for that exact slice?

ian_runtime: Micro-run (256-token median, median of 3): fp16 p95=538ms, int8 p95=467ms (~13.2% reduction). tokens/sec fp16=210, int8=255. est cost/1M fp16=$12.30, int8=$10.55 (staging rates).

samira_prod: Note for sales/blog: add one-liner: "Measured on staging (A10g); prod A100-class GPUs typically improve p95 by ~10-20% depending on batch mix."

ian_runtime: Bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-staging/bench-folded-2180000000/bundle.zip. CSV + runner-config + warmup-seedlist + demo trace included. Runner config snippet below for reproducibility:
```
workers: 6
batching_profiles:
  low_latency: { max_batch_size: 8, max_tokens: 1024 }
  high_throughput: { max_batch_size: 64, max_tokens: 4096 }
warmup_per_worker: 5
repeats: 3
seed_list: bench-folded-2180000000-seed.txt
```

zoe_marketing: Perfect  we'll draft the blog + slide and tag you for sign-off. Thanks team! :rocket:
